data.content_ref: inline:The problem statement explicitly warns that 'a simulation described in prose with an empty simulation_refs channel is an unverified claim and will be criticized as such.' SRC_001 makes a concrete empirical claim — that a GA initialized from Batcher's 48-comparator network can discover a structurally novel 45-comparator network — yet simulation_refs is empty ([]) and formalization_refs is empty. The entire mechanism (iterative comparator removal + local search via endpoint swaps/position shifts using 0-1 principle violation fixing) is described only in prose. There is no typed sandboxed Python simulation filed to run the discriminating experiment of whether this GA strategy actually reaches 45. Additionally, no dossier block ids are cited anywhere in the target, violating the requirement to 'ground every claim about the problem state in the attached dossier blocks by citing their block ids.' The claim that a structurally novel 45 would be found is unsupported by any executable evidence.
